notes: Refined existing stories for clarity, extensibility, and tighter integration alignment. No new IDs created.

change_log.value: Define canonical request/response schemas including unified envelope (status, data, errors, metadata) with explicit extensibility hooks for additional Evaluate Care domains beyond trials and provider detail.

Implement facade orchestration logic routing to clinical_trials_service and provider_detail_service, supporting parallel execution where applicable, aggregation, and normalization into unified schema.
Expose facade via tool_router with allowlisted tools, strict Pydantic validation, and consistent response envelope, ensuring compatibility with main.py agent loop.
Implement shared error taxonomy and normalization layer ensuring consistent error codes, fallback behavior, and partial success handling across domains.
Develop unit and integration tests validating schema compliance, orchestration paths, tool_router invocation, partial failures, and cross-domain consistency.
